cards.ex: The chef presented a culinary masterpiece that wowed all the diners.
cards.exUz: Oshpaz barcha ovqatlanuvchilarni hayratda qoldirgan oshpazlik durdonasini taqdim etdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi tayyorlangan va taqdim etilgan taom, san'at asari kabi.

cards.ex: I'm not eating this because I enjoy it; it's just food for fuel before my marathon.
cards.exUz: Men bundan zavqlanganim uchun emas, balki marafonimdan oldin shunchaki energiya uchun oziq-ovqat sifatida yeyapman.
cards.uzDef: Organizmga quvvat berish uchun iste'mol qilinadigan oziq-ovqat.

cards.ex: The recipe calls for a pinch of saffron, but I didn't have any.
cards.exUz: Retsept bir chimdim za'farni talab qiladi, lekin menda yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Retseptda aytilishicha, masalliqlar yoki harakatlar kerak.

cards.ex: He was so hungry he wolfed down the entire pizza in minutes.
cards.exUz: U juda och edi, shuning uchun butun pitsani bir necha daqiqada yeb qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqatni juda tez va ochko'zlik bilan yemoq.

cards.ex: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
cards.exUz: Guruch Osiyoning ko'plab mamlakatlarida asosiy oziq-ovqat hisoblanadi.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik ratsionning muhim va asosiy qismi bo'lgan oziq-ovqat.

cards.ex: Take your time and savour the flavour of this exquisite dish.
cards.exUz: Shoshilmang va ushbu ajoyib taomning ta'mini to'liq his qiling.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqatning ta'mini to'liq baholab, sekin yemoq.

cards.ex: After a long hike, we enjoyed a hearty meal of stew and bread.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yurishdan so'ng, biz dimlangan go'sht va nondan iborat to'yimli taomdan bahramand bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: To'yimli, serharakat va odatda issiq taom.

cards.ex: I totally burned the candle while I was distracted with a phone call.
cards.exUz: Telefon qo'ng'irog'i bilan chalg'ib ketganimda, men suvni qaynatib yubordim.
cards.uzDef: Ovqat pishirishda, suvni butunlay bug'lanib ketguncha qaynatish.

cards.ex: Add a dash of soy sauce for extra flavour.
cards.exUz: Qo'shimcha ta'm berish uchun bir chimdim soya sousini qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Juda oz miqdordagi narsa, odatda suyuqlik yoki ziravor.

cards.ex: Just add a pinch of salt to bring out the flavour.
cards.exUz: Ta'mini chiqarish uchun faqat bir chimdim tuz qo'shing.
cards.uzDef: Juda oz miqdordagi tuz.

cards.ex: This city is a foodie haven, with endless options for dining.
cards.exUz: Bu shahar gurmeler makoni, ovqatlanish uchun cheksiz imkoniyatlar mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Ajoyib oziq-ovqat va restoranlar ko'pligi bilan mashhur bo'lgan joy.

cards.ex: The smell of baking bread really whets my appetite.
cards.exUz: Pishirilgan nonning hidi haqiqatan ham ishtahamni ochadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa ishtahani ochishga yoki ovqat yeyish istagini uyg'otishga olib kelmoq.

cards.ex: I usually have a light snack in the afternoon to keep me going.
cards.exUz: Men odatda kunduzi o'zimni tetik tutish uchun yengil gazak yeyman.
cards.uzDef: Oz miqdorda yeyiladigan ovqat, asosiy taom emas.

cards.ex: Everyone dug into the delicious buffet.
cards.exUz: Hamma mazali bufetga kirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Taomdan zavqlanib, g'ayrat bilan yemoq.

cards.ex: This apple pie is made using my grandmother's family recipe.
cards.exUz: Bu olma pirogi buvimning oilaviy retsepti bo'yicha tayyorlangan.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolaridan avloddan avlodga o'tadigan retsept.

cards.ex: For expats, this restaurant offers a taste of home.
cards.exUz: Chet elliklar uchun bu restoran uydagi ta'mni taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Uydagi oziq-ovqatni eslatuvchi taom.

cards.ex: I prefer bone-in chicken because it's more flavorful.
cards.exUz: Men suyakli tovuqni afzal ko'raman, chunki u ko'proq mazali.
cards.uzDef: Suyagi bilan birga pishirilgan yoki xizmat qilingan go'sht.

cards.ex: The recipe calls for bone-out chicken thighs.
cards.exUz: Retsept suyaklari olib tashlangan tovuq sonlarini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Suyagi olib tashlangan go'sht.

cards.ex: Season generously with salt and pepper for the best flavour.
cards.exUz: Eng yaxshi ta'm uchun tuz va murch bilan saxiy ziravorlang.
cards.uzDef: Ta'mini yaxshilash uchun oziq-ovqatga ko'p miqdorda ziravorlar qo'shmoq.

cards.ex: I just need a quick bite before I head out.
cards.exUz: Ketishimdan oldin menga shunchaki tez gazak kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tez va oson yeyish uchun oz miqdordagi ovqat.

cards.ex: The cook's secret is adding a touch of honey to the sauce.
cards.exUz: Oshpazning siri - sousga bir oz asal qo'shish.
cards.uzDef: Oshpazning noyob retseptida yoki usulida saqlanadigan maxfiy maslahat.

cards.ex: She's a light eater, so don't make too much food.
cards.exUz: U kam yeydi, shuning uchun juda ko'p ovqat tayyorlamang.
cards.uzDef: Oz miqdorda ovqat yeydigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a big eater, so make sure there's plenty of food.
cards.exUz: U ko'p yeydi, shuning uchun ovqat ko'p bo'lishiga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p miqdorda ovqat yeydigan odam.

cards.ex: The steak was cooked to perfection, juicy and tender.
cards.exUz: Bifshteks mukammal pishirilgan, suvli va yumshoq edi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqatni eng yaxshi ta'm va tuzilishga erishish uchun to'g'ri pishirish.

cards.ex: This cheese pairs well with a crisp white wine.
cards.exUz: Bu pishloq qarsildoq oq vino bilan yaxshi mos keladi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir oziq-ovqat yoki ichimlik boshqasi bilan yaxshi ta'mga ega.

cards.ex: Traveling to different countries is a culinary adventure for me.
cards.exUz: Turli mamlakatlarga sayohat qilish men uchun oshpazlik sarguzashtidir.
cards.uzDef: Yangi taomlar va pishirish usullarini sinab ko'rishning qiziqarli tajribasi.

cards.ex: Whether you like spicy food is just a matter of taste.
cards.exUz: Achchiq ovqatni yoqtirish yoki yoqtirmaslik faqat ta'm masalasidir.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy didga bog'liq bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Reducing food miles can help to lower your carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Oziq-ovqat masofasini kamaytirish uglerod izini kamaytirishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Oziq-ovqat mahsulotining ishlab chiqarish joyidan iste'molchiga yetib borguncha bosib o'tgan masofasi.

cards.ex: The restaurant caters to those with a discerning palate.
cards.exUz: Restoran farosatli ta'm egalariga xizmat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Nozik ta'mlarni sezishga qodir va ovqatni yuqori baholaydigan ta'm.

cards.ex: The city is a melting pot of different cuisines.
cards.exUz: Shahar turli oshxonalarning aralashmasidir.
cards.uzDef: Turli xil madaniyatlarning aralashmasi.
